subject: Mental Models
title: Ship of Theseus
description: A short lesson to help you apply Ship of Theseus.

hook.text: An ancient ship has every plank replaced over the years. Not a single original piece remains. Is it still the same ship?

buildup.text: The Ship of Theseus asks when gradual change destroys identity.

discovery.text: Plutarch recorded this paradox around 75 AD.

twist.text: Your body replaces most of its cells every seven to ten years.

climax.text: Identity may live in patterns and relationships, not in physical parts.

punchline.text: Identity lives in the pattern, not the parts.

quiz.question: Who recorded the Ship of Theseus paradox?
